thread:
maya: Quick heads up — I'll be offline 2025-08-12 06:00 UTC -> 2025-08-12 14:00 UTC for a medical appointment. Need someone to take primary for that window. We're currently on incident watch for LATENCY-231 (DB write latency spikes), so I'm asking for a short preflight swap + shadowing.

incident-bot: Incident LATENCY-231 active — status: monitoring. Pager sent to maya, jon. Link: https://redwood.incidents/LATENCY-231

jon: I can cover primary if needed but note I'm travelling then — wifi might be flaky. Prefer to be infra approver / secondary rather than primary if priya can take it.

priya: I can take primary for 06:00-14:00 UTC. Would like a shadow for the first hour (06:00-07:00) to transfer context. 05:30 handover works for me.

tess: I can shadow 06:00-07:00 and take pager backup. Where's the runbook for the DB write latency mitigations?

maya: Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/db-write-latency — key quick steps pasted below. Short checklist in the handover doc too.

maya: ```
# quick checks
curl -s "https://metrics.api/internal/latency?metric=write_p95" | jq .
kubectl get hpa writepool -n inference
kubectl scale deployment writepool --replicas=6 -n inference
# escalate: toggle failover flag via vault actions; requires 2 approvers
```

liam: Noted. Who holds the KMS token for failover toggle? Last time tess had it.

tess: I have the KMS token for the failover toggle. Will keep it ready.

ops-bot: Emergency actions checklist stored: https://vault.redwood/ops/actions; failover flag requires 2 approvers (primary + infra lead). Current infra lead on rotation: @jon.

jon: I can be infra-approver remotely for that window. If I'm unreachable, assign infra approval to @liam.

maya: Plan: priya = primary 06:00-14:00 UTC. jon = infra approver & secondary remote. tess = shadow 06:00-07:00 and pager backup. liam = escalation standby. I'll run a 05:30 handover (30m) covering state + open tabs.

priya: Ack — I'll take primary. Can someone paste current open runbook checkpoints / hot actions?

maya: Current state: incident shows intermittent write p95 spikes ~850ms (baseline ~120ms). Error rate low. Recent mitigations: prefix cache warmed, writepool at 4 replicas. Flaky node flagged (nvidia-gpu-12) but not blocking.

tess: I'll add a short checklist to the runbook for priya: - check p95 & error-rate - if p95 > 400ms for >10m, scale writepool to 6 - confirm cache hitrate > 80% - if write errors > 0.5%, enable degraded-mode for non-critical ops - contact infra for node replacement

priya: Got it.

liam: I'll monitor alerts and stand ready. If we need failover, ensure both primary + infra approver explicitly thumbs.

jon: Quick question — who owns customer comms if latency crosses threshold? We saw a gap last week.

maya: For this window: primary (priya) notifies CS if error rate >1% or p95 >1s for >15m. CS lead is @tess — she'll take comms + notes.

tess: I can handle comms if we hit the threshold. I'll prep a template.

priya: One more ask — can we mute noisy non-critical alerts 05:45-06:15 during the handover? There are a bunch of internal detectors that will distract.

ops-bot: Alert suppression scheduled: suppression_id=sup-7590001 by maya. Active 05:45->06:15 UTC. Suppressed: internal-db-flags, debug-telemetry. Critical alerts remain active.

jon: Approved. I'll route infra-approver notifications to my mobile; ping me @jon_urgent if escalating.

maya: Handover agenda @05:30 (30m): - incident recap (5m) - console walkthrough + metrics (10m) - runbook bookmarks + emergency actions (10m) - confirm contacts + docs (5m). I will DM vault access to priya and tess now.

maya: Also — priya, during the first hour please confirm that scaling writepool actually reduces p95 before we keep it scaled. If scaling doesn't help, run the failover checklist.

priya: Understood. I'll log the handover notes in the incident thread and keep the team updated.

tess: :thumbsup: I'll be on the call and ready to execute scaling commands.

jon: I'll be available for infra approval. If something critical pops, call my mobile.

maya: Thanks everyone — appreciate the cover. I'll post the handoff note at 05:30 and set my status. :heart:

incident-bot: Reminder: scheduled handover at 05:30 UTC for thread 7590001111. Auto-notify participants at 05:25 UTC.
